violence_policy: keep active v3, no training or threshold changes

asr.segments: all decoder-accepted nonempty segments; no second no_speech filter

training.trainable: last two encoder blocks and classifier
training.labels: user-reported weak clip labels; no invented human annotations

selection.constraints: hybrid FP <= baseline hybrid FP; hybrid recall >= baseline hybrid recall; model-only FP <= baseline model-only FP
selection.rank: eligible first, lowest hybrid FP, highest hybrid recall, lowest log loss, earliest epoch

test_policy: Do not transcribe, select on or evaluate the previously seen test in this run. No new independent test claim.
deployment: candidate only until manual review and broader regression; do not auto-activate
review_policy: ten train/validation disagreements only; human labels start blank; not an accuracy sample
